t: Milwaukee Shockwave 1/4" Hex Shank PZ1 Impact Screwdriver Bits are engineered for professional use with impact drivers, offering a robust fastening solution for heavy-duty applications. These durable impact bits are ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders tackling demanding tasks on site. Featuring laser-hardened Wear Guard Tip technology, they deliver enhanced wear resistance and maintain a precise fit. Optimised Shockzone geometry flexes to reduce stress and minimise breakages by absorbing impacts. Manufactured from custom-engineered steel, these Milwaukee Shockwave bits provide increased resistance to shock from high-torque impact driving.
b: Suitable for Power Screwdrivers with Impact Mode
